mgmt_bio.text: Sandy Ran Xu became chief executive of JD.com in May 2023, making history as the first woman to hold the role at the company. She joined JD.com in 2018 and served as chief financial officer from June 2020, bringing a background that is both financial and operational. She holds a dual degree in information science and economics from Peking University, is a CPA in both China and the United States, and also serves as an independent director at Baidu.
